g.text: TIMBER AI / MATERIAL AVAILABILITY AS A DESIGN STATE
From source evidence to allocated parts, assembled geometry and separate structural review.
Role candidates support exploration. Allocation feasibility does not certify the material or building.
02 YOU DIRECT. THE AGENT PROPOSES. TOOLS COMPUTE.
Proposal returns to you for acceptance
Each model reply is distinct from imports, saves and confirmation events.
Source intervals: P01 [0, 330.2] · P02 [333.2, 2319.7] · residual [2322.7, 2438.4] mm. Two 3 mm kerfs.
04 FROM PARTS TO THE ASSEMBLED MODEL
Display sequence only; it is not a verified erection plan. Conceptual analysis is not structural approval.
